cohort: The study included 44,295 nulliparous women with term singleton gestations (39,496 < 35 years and 4,799 >= 35 years) who delivered between 2003 and 2017.
finding: Advanced maternal age in nulliparous women was associated with an increased likelihood of C-sections and intrauterine fetal demise, but a decreased risk of instrumental delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, and severe perineal tears.
mod_finding: Women with advanced maternal age were more likely to have both medically indicated and self-requested cesarean sections, but less likely to have instrumental deliveries compared to younger nulliparous women.
